items.title: Critical Ivanti Endpoint Manager RCE Vulnerabilities Actively Exploited in Attacks
items.description: Two critical code-injection vulnerabilities have been disclosed in the Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) platform, which are currently being actively exploited in real-world attacks.
